task: Propose no more than four implementation increments for the invitation feature, with a selected first increment, dependencies, and verification. Do not create tickets.
context: Required outcome: an authorized workspace owner invites an existing account; the recipient accepts and gains membership. Invitations can later expire or be cancelled. New-account registration and bulk invites are out of scope. Current proposal: task 1 database tables, task 2 service endpoints, task 3 interface, task 4 tests. Two workers are available, but both would edit the membership module if work is divided solely by interface and service. Existing authentication can be reused.
expected: Provides at most four increments defined by demonstrable behavior rather than only database/service/interface layers.
Makes the first selected increment an authorized invite-and-accept path for an existing account, with observable membership verification.
Accounts for expiry/cancellation, the shared membership write area, real dependencies, and excluded bulk/new-account scope.
forbidden: Treating completion of one technical layer as a working end-to-end feature.
Assigning overlapping mutable membership work to two workers without an ownership/integration plan.
evidence: Increment outcomes and acceptance observations, dependency reasons, selected ready work and integration ownership.
